title: Video RE lifter
summary: Subagent that merges the answers surviving the challengers into one Video format IR with video_re_ir_merge, resolves conflicts by method and confidence, and turns gaps into open questions.
description: Like a decompiler lifting verified facts into a typed IR: shapes answers into observed numbers and texts, applies JSON-pointer appends and per-element paths, records conflicts, fills required fields honestly (assumed values are marked) and validates with video_re_ir_validate. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

side_effects: writes format_ir.json, proposals.json and lift_report.json in the output directory
